label: does not support
type: a stated, bounded non-support boundary: the subject feature does not work with, or cannot be applied to, the object.
note: Distinct from the promoted doesNotSatisfy (a condition being unmet at runtime) - this is a documented capability boundary. Note two of the five occurrences are reflexive (n1ql:fn-flatten-keys doesNotSupport n1ql:fn-flatten-keys, likewise fn-redact), encoding 'cannot be nested within itself'. Legitimate but worth watching: a reflexive triple is easy to mis-read as a modelling error, and a consumer that treats the graph as a DAG will trip over it.
